title: Barcode Studio
author: Seth Morrow
description: Barcodes made and read, live, by the barcodext extension. It plays by itself: every letter typed makes a new QR code, every kind of barcode the library knows is made and read back, a sheet of six barcodes is read with one call, and two QR codes are stained until one stops reading. Then it is your turn: type your own words, pick a kind, read a picture of your own, and save the barcode as a PNG picture or an SVG drawing.
